articles.title: The World’s Largest Steam Locomotive Is Thundering Across America—Here’s Why It’s a Big Deal
articles.summary: Union Pacific’s Big Boy No. 4014, a 1.2-million-pound steam locomotive, is touring the U.S. for the nation’s 250th anniversary. It’s the only one of its kind still operating, and crowds are flocking to see it.

articles.title: FBI Delivers Subpoenas to NYT Reporters Over Air Force One Leaks, Sparking Press Freedom Alarm
articles.summary: Four New York Times journalists were subpoenaed after reporting on security flaws in the new Air Force One. The Justice Department says it’s targeting leakers, but press advocates call it an unprecedented intimidation tactic.

articles.title: NYT Reporters Subpoenaed Over Air Force One Security Leaks, Escalating Trump’s Press Crackdown
articles.summary: Federal agents delivered subpoenas to four New York Times journalists after they reported that the new Air Force One lacks critical defenses. The Justice Department says it’s targeting leakers, but press advocates see a dangerous pattern of intimidation.
